title: private-deployments-weekly-2026-05-18
content:
Private Deployments — Engineering Weekly Update (2026-05-18)

Attendees:
- Aisha Rao (owner)
- Diego Morales
- Lena Park
- Omar Singh
- Katie Wu (SRE)
- Customer success: Priya Patel (joined for customer-specific items)

Summary / Context:
Weekly sync for private deployments (VPC & on-prem installs). Focus this week on three customer installs in flight, a recurring firewall/VPN blocker pattern, and rollout of the new installer that supports SAT/HA control-plane for air-gapped installs. Goal: identify unblockers and assign clear owners for install completion and next-phase hardening.

Active installs and status:
1) ACME Health (on-prem, air-gapped) — status: in-progress
   - Progress: Installer 0.9.3 deployed to staging; control-plane boots but some worker nodes fail kubelet registration intermittently.
   - Blockers: Custom NTP and internal PKI policy at customer causing cert rotation failures during kubelet start. Customer's security team requires certs signed by their internal CA; our current flow expects a provided CA bundle at install time.
   - Actions: Omar to prepare an installer patch that accepts a pre-loaded CA and disables our auto-rotate step (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-deployments/pull/812). Diego to coordinate with Priya to get exact CA bundle and test node join. Target: unblock by 2026-05-21.

2) Nova Financial (VPC deployment in customer AWS account) — status: stalled / customer blocker
   - Progress: VPC peering and route tables configured; control-plane in customer subnets. 
   - Blockers: Customer has restrictive egress egress rules; image pull from our registry blocked by corporate proxy. They request an option to mirror images into an internal ECR and update installer to use provided registry endpoints. Also need KMS integration for envelope encryption (customer KMS key must be configured).
   - Actions: Lena to document mirror image workflow and create a small tool/script to sync images to ECR (task PD-689). Diego to create KMS configuration example; raise a short RFC for registry mirroring timeline. Customer success to coordinate procurement of IAM role for ECR access. ETA: limited demo by 2026-05-25.

3) RetailCo (VPC + hybrid on-prem cache) — status: on-track
   - Progress: Installer 0.9.2 on customer's VPC; caching layer (on-prem redis) integration tested. Load tests show ~95th percentile latency meets SLA.
   - Blockers: Intermittent DNS resolution errors for internal S3-like object store used for model artifacts; appears to be split-horizon DNS issue.
   - Actions: Katie to work with customer DNS team and add fallback to IP-based endpoints in our artifact-fetcher. Expected fix in next minor release 0.9.4.

Recurring blockers / patterns observed:
- Firewall/proxy egress rules: multiple customers restrict outbound access and require image mirroring + proxy support in installer. Need a robust documented path and tooling for image mirroring and proxy configs. (Related tickets: PD-691, PD-689).
- Internal PKI/CAs: Air-gapped installs often require customer-supplied CA bundles. Our current auto-rotation assumptions break in those environments. Need an "external CA" flow in the installer to skip rotation and use pre-provided certs.
- NFS / Storage mount permissions: A couple of installs hit permission issues when mounting NFS shares for persistent volumes — requires clearer docs on expected UID/GID and SELinux flags.

Engineering work completed this week:
- Installer: added initial support for configurable registry endpoints and proxy env vars (branch merged to staging).
- Telemetry: small change to telemetry collector to include install-mode = {vpc,on-prem,airgap}. Patch in INF-2345.
- Docs: new runbook draft for image mirroring and proxy configuration posted to Confluence.

Open risks:
- If we do not ship an image-mirroring workflow soon, we risk multiple stalled installs and higher touch from CS/Solutions.
- The external CA flow needs security review; skipping our rotation has potential long-term upgrade risks. Must define upgrade path for external CA installs.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Omar: Installer patch to accept pre-loaded CA and disable auto-rotate. ETA 2026-05-21. (linked PR)
- Diego: Coordinate CA exchange with ACME Health and run node join validation. ETA 2026-05-22.
- Lena: Image mirroring tool and docs for ECR sync. Create PD-689. ETA 2026-05-25.
- Diego: KMS example config and short RFC for customer KMS integration. ETA 2026-05-24.
- Katie: DNS fallback for artifact fetcher and include IP-based fallback. ETA targeted next release 0.9.4 (2026-05-28).
- Priya (CS): Collect SOC/compliance questions for external CA flow and route to security. ETA 2026-05-20.

Meeting notes / decisions:
- We agreed to prioritize image mirroring tooling as a high-impact unblocker for multiple customers. Lena owns execution.
- For air-gapped ACME install, we will temporarily accept their CA bundle and disable auto-rotate; long-term, security will draft an approved upgrade path.
- We will add a new "install checklist" to the runbook that enumerates network/proxy/KMS/CA requirements to reduce back-and-forth during onboarding.

Follow-ups for next week:
- Demo image mirroring to Nova Financial and confirm ECR IAM role.
- Validate ACME node joins after CA patch.
- Ship telemetry tag for install-mode to help product/ops dashboards.
- Draft proposal for external CA upgrade path and get security review.

Notes to self / working thoughts (informal):
- Consider supporting a tarball of images that the installer can load in air-gapped mode (fast but larger UX footprint).
- Explore adding a small sidecar registry proxy that can cache images during install to avoid full mirror in short-term installs.

References / links:
- Runbook (draft): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PD/Private+Deployments+Runbook
- Jira: PD-689, PD-691, INF-2345
- Installer PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-deployments/pull/812

End of notes.
